entities.name: Church of Our Lady on the Sand in Wrocław
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Church of St. Mary on the Sand is a Catholic church in Wrocław, in Silesia, located on the Sand Island, in the Oder River, in the heart of the city. Founded in the 12th century, it is one of the oldest Gothic churches in the country.
